content.short: Symbiosis is a multi-chain liquidity protocol that enables single-transaction cross-chain swaps including TON.
content.description: Symbiosis is a decentralized multi-chain liquidity protocol that aggregates liquidity from various decentralized exchanges across multiple blockchains. It allows users to perform cross-chain swaps in a single transaction, regardless of the source or destination network. By integrating TON, Symbiosis enables users to swap any token on any supported chain for Toncoin or other Jettons with minimal slippage and a simplified user experience. This protocol significantly reduces the friction involved in navigating the multi-chain DeFi landscape.
content.meta: Perform one-click cross-chain swaps with Symbiosis. Trade tokens across chains including TON on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
